title: Codec with dropout: the width curve at dropout 0.3, and dropout 0.5
description: Step 3 of the plan (docs/methodology.md). Dropout 0.3 in the encoder and decoder raised the skill of the codec at both widths tried in release exp-codec-variants-5 and was the largest value tried, so two things are open: whether the count of latents read from fixed-width models changes once the model is regularized, and whether more dropout helps further. Cells drop0.3-fixedK train a codec with K latents, all kept, at dropout 0.3 for K in 2, 3, 4, 6, 12 and 16; with the 8-latent and 64-latent models at dropout 0.3 of exp-codec-variants-5 they make the width curve. Cells drop0.5 train the 8-latent and the 64-latent model at dropout 0.5. Seeds 0 to 2. Other settings are those of release exp-codec-confirm-4 (learning rate 1e-3, width 512, encoder depth 4, weight decay 1e-4, all training anchors of release exp-phase0-steps-2, 10 epochs, links split 70/15/15 with split seed 0). Scores are on validation links only; the test links are not read.
run: VARIANT=${JOB%%-*}; REST=${JOB#*-}; MODEL=${REST%-s*}; SEED=${JOB##*-s}; case "$MODEL" in wide64) K=64;; fixed*) K=${MODEL#fixed};; *) exit 2;; esac; case "$VARIANT" in drop*) DROPOUT=${VARIANT#drop};; *) exit 2;; esac; uv run python experiments/codec.py train "$OUT/runs/$JOB" --data "$IN/steps" --set dropout=$DROPOUT --set k=$K --set nested=false --set seed=$SEED --set lr=0.001 --set width=512 --set depth=4 --set dec_width=512 --set weight_decay=0.0001 --set epochs=10 --set time_budget_s=18000
